scope: Public legal and quasi-legal sources relevant to Miller North accountability evidence and Miller practical legal context/resources.

sources.date_coverage: Generally comprehensive after 2001; varies by database, with historical backfill in some collections
sources.query_method: bounded full-text and citation search by database and jurisdiction
sources.access_limitations: Public interface; avoid uncontrolled scraping and prefer an official court or tribunal copy when practical
sources.privacy_considerations: Decisions can contain extensive personal and medical detail; preserve anonymization and minimize public summaries

sources.date_coverage: Supreme Court reports and historical judgments; official coverage varies by era
sources.query_method: official collection search by citation, party and full text
sources.access_limitations: public
sources.privacy_considerations: Respect court anonymization and avoid unrelated medical or criminal history

sources.agency: Federal Court and Federal Court of Appeal
sources.date_coverage: official online collection with historical coverage
sources.query_method: citation, party and bounded full-text search
sources.access_limitations: public
sources.privacy_considerations: Preserve anonymization and distinguish pleadings, interlocutory rulings and final findings

sources.date_coverage: public decision collection
sources.query_method: citation, party and full-text search
sources.access_limitations: public
sources.privacy_considerations: Do not treat complaint intake or procedural rulings as merits findings; preserve pseudonyms

sources.date_coverage: current guidance and selected historical reports
sources.query_method: site index and publication search
sources.access_limitations: individual complaint files are not public decisions
sources.privacy_considerations: Complaint acceptance is not a merits finding; do not seek private complaint files

sources.date_coverage: decisions by year plus recent releases
sources.query_method: recent HTML index, year indexes and CanLII full-text search
sources.access_limitations: public; official signed decision controls if a copy differs
sources.privacy_considerations: Preserve pseudonyms; record procedural stage before summarizing any allegation

sources.date_coverage: selected Tribunal decisions and later court proceedings
sources.query_method: HTML table keyed to Tribunal decision
sources.access_limitations: public; follow linked court reasons for the controlling result
sources.privacy_considerations: Court disposition may address procedure or standard of review rather than the merits

sources.agency: Court of Appeal and Supreme Court of British Columbia
sources.date_coverage: official recent and searchable historical judgments
sources.query_method: official judgment search and bounded CanLII cross-check
sources.access_limitations: public
sources.privacy_considerations: Distinguish pleadings, applications, reasons and final disposition; minimize medical details

sources.date_coverage: current process and annual reports
sources.query_method: annual-report and site-page review
sources.access_limitations: individual reviews are generally privacy-protected and not a public case-law corpus
sources.privacy_considerations: Use aggregate public reporting only; do not seek identifiable complaint files

sources.agency: College of Physicians and Surgeons of BC
sources.date_coverage: current and archived public publications
sources.query_method: incremental publication index plus mechanism and Indigenous-term search
sources.access_limitations: public summaries can omit underlying patient identity and full complaint record
sources.privacy_considerations: Do not identify affected patients or infer identity; regulator summary controls the finding

sources.agency: BC College of Nurses and Midwives
sources.date_coverage: current and archived public notices
sources.query_method: body-only notice parsing and incremental ID/fingerprint comparison
sources.access_limitations: public notices only; underlying complaint files are private
sources.privacy_considerations: Keep unnamed affected people anonymous and limit practitioner details to accountability relevance

sources.agency: Independent Investigations Office of BC and Office of the Police Complaint Commissioner
sources.date_coverage: public reports and selected historical dispositions
sources.query_method: bounded search for hospital, ambulance, apprehension and healthcare-security intersections
sources.access_limitations: only matters within statutory jurisdiction are public
sources.privacy_considerations: Police findings do not by themselves establish healthcare discrimination

sources.agency: Alberta Human Rights Commission and Tribunal
sources.date_coverage: selected summaries; Tribunal decisions are published through CanLII
sources.query_method: official summary filters plus scoped CanLII search
sources.access_limitations: official site is not a complete full-text decision corpus
sources.privacy_considerations: Distinguish complaint screening, hearing, merits and remedy stages

sources.agency: Court of Justice, Court of King's Bench and Court of Appeal of Alberta
sources.date_coverage: official and CanLII collections; coverage varies by court and era
sources.query_method: bounded citation and full-text search
sources.access_limitations: public judgments only
sources.privacy_considerations: Pleadings and interlocutory rulings are not findings; preserve publication bans and anonymization

sources.date_coverage: current and historical public reports
sources.query_method: report archive and named-body search
sources.access_limitations: individual complaint files are confidential; published summaries are selective
sources.privacy_considerations: Use only public summaries and avoid inferring facts from complaint existence

sources.agency: College of Registered Nurses of Alberta
sources.date_coverage: public disciplinary decisions available through the current index
sources.query_method: index and bounded mechanism search
sources.access_limitations: not every complaint produces a public decision
sources.privacy_considerations: Do not identify patients; findings are limited to the published decision

sources.date_coverage: public decisions from 2018 onward are generally posted for at least five years; not all outcomes are public
sources.query_method: document index and mechanism search
sources.access_limitations: statutory publication limits; underlying complaint records are private
sources.privacy_considerations: Patient identities and medical detail must remain minimized

sources.date_coverage: current process guidance; no practical broad public merits-decision corpus located
sources.query_method: official process pages and bounded court-review search
sources.access_limitations: individual RTDRS decisions are not presented as a comprehensive searchable public database
sources.privacy_considerations: Do not infer facts from an application or order reference without the public decision

document_types: complaint decision where selected for publication
sources.date_coverage: annual reporting and selected published decisions; not a complete merits-decision archive
sources.query_method: site publications, exact-document search and Saskatchewan court/CanLII cross-check
sources.access_limitations: many complaint-stage decisions and resolutions are not public; court process replaced the former tribunal model
sources.pagination_behavior: publication archive and external court search
sources.privacy_considerations: Do not treat aggregate complaint counts as event records or screened complaints as merits findings

sources.agency: Court of King's Bench and Court of Appeal for Saskatchewan
sources.date_coverage: official notices and CanLII judgment collections
sources.query_method: bounded CanLII and exact-citation search
sources.access_limitations: public judgments only; some complaint resolution remains outside published court decisions
sources.privacy_considerations: Respect anonymization, sealing orders and procedural posture

sources.date_coverage: current and historical public reports
sources.query_method: report archive and bounded health/social-services search
sources.access_limitations: individual complaint records are confidential; published case summaries are selective
sources.privacy_considerations: Use public summaries only and retain the Ombudsman's stated scope and conclusion

sources.date_coverage: current guidance; no complete public searchable merits archive located
sources.query_method: official process pages and bounded court-review search
sources.access_limitations: individual decisions are not exposed as a broad public corpus
sources.privacy_considerations: Do not reconstruct tenant histories from scattered public records

sources.agency: College of Physicians and Surgeons of Saskatchewan
sources.date_coverage: public disciplinary material in the current regulator index
sources.query_method: index and bounded mechanism search
sources.access_limitations: not every complaint is public
sources.privacy_considerations: Do not identify patients; hearing notices are allegations until a result is published

sources.date_coverage: office launch through current public reporting
sources.query_method: publication index and changed-document fingerprinting
sources.access_limitations: individual complaint files are not public
sources.privacy_considerations: Use aggregate reporting and explicitly public incidents only; treat First Nations-led evidence as a substantive source role

sources.date_coverage: current program and selected historical legal/accountability updates
sources.query_method: named-order, program and settlement-page monitoring
sources.access_limitations: government implementation claims require independent or tribunal follow-up before being treated as outcomes
sources.privacy_considerations: Use aggregate/systemic information; do not collect child-level request records
